text:
Mia Tran: Quick sync — planning the SEO checklist for May 10 webinar launch. Need redirects, primary/secondary keyword list, schema snippets for webinar page, internal link plan, and inbound lead routing for the gated asset. @Jon can you own redirects? :raised_hands:

Jon Patel: Yep. I'll map redirects. Can someone drop current landing URL + new post URL?

Sara Gomez: Landing is /webinar-ml-inference, new blog is /blog/webinar-inference-launch. I can start internal linking plan.

Dave Liu: For inbound routing — we should tag webinar signups with source=webinar + utm_campaign=webinar_may. Then route to SDR queue 'webinar-may' via HubSpot workflow.

Jon Patel: Redirects initial mapping (quick draft):
```
/old/webinar-ml-inference -> /webinars/inference-may-2026  301
/blog/old-inference -> /blog/webinar-inference-launch         301
/legacy/inference -> /docs/serving-runtime                     302
```
I'll PR to nextops redirect repo after review.

Mia Tran: Nice. Keywords: primary: "LLM inference platform", "low-latency LLM serving". Secondary: "inference cost optimization", "dedicated inference", "private inference deployment".

Sara Gomez: I'll bake those into headings/meta + FAQ schema. For schema, we should use Event + FAQ — Event for the webinar, FAQ for common post questions.

Jon Patel: Add `structured_data: Event` snippet, will paste sample in doc later.

DevBot: Reminder — redirect PR template requires rollback plan and smoke test steps.

Dave Liu: For inbound routing, we need explicit HubSpot properties: lead_source=webinar, campaign_id=webinar_may_2026, product_interest=inference. I'll create the workflow and test.

Mia Tran: Action items: Jon -> redirects map + PR by Tue EOD; Sara -> content + schema draft by Wed; Dave -> HubSpot workflow + SDR mapping by Thu; I'll coordinate messaging and release notes. Any blockers?

Jon Patel: Need confirm on old URL set — devops, can you expose list from nginx logs? @DevOps

Sara Gomez: Also propose adding internal contextual links from docs: /docs/serving-runtime and /docs/optimize to the webinar post. That helps rank for technical queries.

Mia Tran: Love it. Small QA: canonical strategy for blog vs webinar landing — prefer canonical to webinar landing, blog keeps self-canonical. Agree?

Dave Liu: Noted. Will ensure the HubSpot workflow sets referrer and canonical tags in the thank-you page.

Jon Patel: I'll add smoke test plan: `curl -I https://redwood.com/webinar-ml-inference` check for 301/302 + location header + final 200 and canonical present.

Mia Tran: Great, thanks team :rocket: I'll summarize in the launch checklist doc and link back here: https://redwood.internals/docs/launch-checklist/webinar-may-2026

DevOps: Can pull nginx hit list by EOD and DM Jon.

Sara Gomez: One more ask — can we get an SEO health quick audit 24 hrs before launch? Just meta + OG + structured data smoke.

Mia Tran: Yep include that in the checklist. Closing notes: prioritize redirects + schema ASAP, internal links next, then inbound routing. We'll reconvene Fri morning for final signoff.
